summary.name: ClickUp
summary.one_liner: ClickUp is an all-in-one work management workspace combining tasks, docs, chat, goals, and AI agents (Brain² and Super Agents) in one place.
use_cases: consolidate work tools into one workspace
search work context and get answers with AI
build dashboards or presentations from ideas
track goals and projects across teams
summary.what_it_does: The page presents ClickUp as a single workspace that connects tasks, docs, conversations and goals to AI features. Brain² is described as an AI layer that uses workspace context, lets users choose among models such as GPT, Claude Opus and Gemini, and can pull in data from apps like Google Drive, GitHub and Salesforce. Artifacts² is described as generating presentations, software, dashboards and games from prompts. Super Agents are described as handling updates, handoffs and follow-ups automatically. The page also lists ROI and time-saving figures attributed to third-party research and ClickUp-commissioned claims, which are not independently verified here.
notable: Brain² AI layer with access to workspace context and multiple AI models
Super Agents that keep working on updates and handoffs
Artifacts² for generating dashboards, presentations and software from ideas
Integrations named include Google Drive, GitHub and Salesforce
caveats: Page says 'Free forever. No credit card.' but paid tiers are implied by 'One subscription' for Brain² and are not detailed on this page
ROI, hours-saved and revenue figures are vendor-presented claims based on third-party research and are not verified here
Platform list on the page is limited to the web app; desktop and mobile apps are not mentioned
